definition_and_source: AP+IB+dual-enrolment course enrolments per 100 students, CRDC 2023-24; a student in two programmes counts twice; SD from 2021-22 vs 2023-24
node_basis: course enrolments per 100 students; equal steps

definition_and_source: FTE counsellors per 1,000 students, CRDC 2023-24; SD from two waves
node_basis: 4 per 1,000 is the ASCA-recommended 250:1 ratio

definition_and_source: Violent crimes per 100,000, mean of 2022-2025 FBI agency counts (Chicago: CPD 2021 total 25,979, which includes aggravated battery); denominator Census city population, except FBI agency population for Charlotte-Mecklenburg, Las Vegas Metropolitan and Metro Nashville; SD = SD of annual rates / sqrt(4)
node_basis: violent crimes per 100,000; worst node is also the reference floor
role: floor (<= 1200, not compensable) + compensable value above it

definition_and_source: Traffic deaths per 100,000 residents by crash location, FARS 2021-2024 mean; SD = SD of annual rates / sqrt(4)
node_basis: traffic deaths per 100,000; worst node is also the reference floor

definition_and_source: Percent of monitored days with AQI above 100, county monitors weighted by the city's residents in each county, EPA 2021-2024 mean
node_basis: percent of days with AQI above 100 (EPA 'unhealthy for sensitive groups' or worse)
role: floor (<= 30, not compensable) + compensable value above it

definition_and_source: FTE nurses+psychologists+social workers per 1,000 students, CRDC 2023-24; counsellors are counted only in E3
node_basis: nurses+psychologists+social workers per 1,000 students

definition_and_source: SAMHSA-listed mental-health facilities accepting children/adolescents per 100,000 residents under 18 (facility postal city; no capacity measure); Poisson SD
node_basis: listed youth mental-health facilities per 100,000 under 18

definition_and_source: Population-weighted mean National Walkability Index (1-20) over block groups inside the city, SLD v3
node_basis: EPA National Walkability Index category boundaries

definition_and_source: Fare in USD paid by an eligible high-school student for one local ride on the principal operator (0 = free); Dallas and Indianapolis values are 3-hour and 2-hour passes
node_basis: USD per ride; 0 = free

definition_and_source: Percent of residents within a 10-minute walk of a park, TPL; Charlotte and Nashville are county-scale, three cities have unconfirmed measurement year; SD 0.3 for rounding
node_basis: percent of residents within a 10-minute walk of a park

definition_and_source: Young-adult library programme attendance per 1,000 service-area residents, IMLS FY2023-FY2024 mean over associated systems; Fort Worth from the Texas FY2024 state table
node_basis: teen library programme attendance per 1,000 residents

definition_and_source: Missing for ['0667000']: under 25% of students are in schools that report any athletics programme. Interscholastic athletics participations per 100 students, CRDC 2023-24; a student in two sports counts twice
node_basis: school sports participations per 100 students

definition_and_source: Statutory minimum hourly wage for a 16-17-year-old in an ordinary covered job (as of 2026-11-11), divided by the 2024 BEA all-items regional price parity
node_basis: price-adjusted minimum hourly wage for ages 16-17, USD

definition_and_source: HUD FY2024 two-bedroom Fair Market Rent x 12 as percent of the $80,000 reference household income
node_basis: 2-bedroom rent as percent of reference income; 30 = HUD affordability standard, 50 = HUD severe burden (reference floor)
role: floor (<= 50, not compensable) + compensable value above it

definition_and_source: Mean of BEA 2024 regional price parities for goods and for other services (US = 100), MSA level; housing and utilities excluded to avoid overlap with C1
node_basis: BEA price parity for goods and other services, US = 100

definition_and_source: HRC MEI 2025 parts I (non-discrimination laws, 30) and III (municipal services, 12) as percent of 42; Washington DC is not rated and stays missing
node_basis: percent of MEI parts I and III

definition_and_source: Students with one or more out-of-school suspensions per 100 students, CRDC 2023-24 (with and without disabilities)
node_basis: students suspended out of school per 100

definition_and_source: As E2 but only non-charter schools (CRDC 2021-22 charter flag), i.e. schools a resident enrols in by address
node_basis: four-year graduation rate of non-charter schools, percent

definition_and_source: Mean of typical Saturday and Sunday revenue hours divided by typical weekday revenue hours, principal operator, NTD 2022-2025 mean
node_basis: weekend service hours as a share of weekday hours

definition_and_source: Population-weighted mean of SLD D5br over block groups inside the city: thousands of jobs reachable within a 45-minute transit commute (walk + scheduled transit, distance-decay, TravelTime API 2020 with 2017 jobs); block groups with no transit within walking distance count as 0
node_basis: thousand jobs reachable within 45 minutes by transit (SLD D5br)
